description: One trader's public record. Accounts are private by default: a private account answers private: true, its name and nothing else (only its owner, signed in, gets the full record). A public record is the standing (all-time rank when they qualify, lifetime P&L since Sep 1, 2026 across every reset, the current run, resets and busts), every reset with the result of the run it ended, a W-L-P tally over settled picks, win rate and open pick count. Pass picks=true to include their recent picks. Accepts a user id or a display name (case-insensitive). No sign-in required.

limit.description: Picks to include when picks=true. Default 25, max 100.

trader.description: User id, or a display name. ref is the same argument.

name: get_trader
title: Public trader record
